question: Which of the following is a non-metal that can exist in different form?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Carbon**:-

 
 
• It is a non-metal that can exist in different forms, such as diamond, graphite, and fullerene.
 
• Carbon is a non-metal that can exist in different forms or allotropes.
 
• The most common forms of carbon are diamond, graphite, and fullerene.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mercury:-**

 
 
• It is a metal and exists as a liquid at room temperature.
 
 
 
• **Lithium and Potassium:-**
 
 
• These are both alkali metals and exist in solid form at room temperature.
